ListEmailSentResult.name: ListEmailSentResult
ListEmailSentResult.description: Represents the results of a list email sent from Salesforce, or sent from Account Engagement and synced to Salesforce. It contains transport headers and information specific to the associated send action.

ActionCadenceStepTrackerId.description: The ID of the action cadence step tracker related to the individual recipient of the list email. Used for automated emails in Sales Engagement. Users must have the Sales Engagement Cadence Creator or Sales Engagement User permission enabled.

ActivityId.description: The task representation of the sent email.

EmailAdress.description: The email address of the recipient.

FirstClickedDate.description: The timestamp for when the email link was first clicked.

FirstOpenedDate.description: The timestamp for when the email was first opened.

HasReply.description: Indicates whether the email has a reply (true) or not (false) The default value is false.

Headers.description: The internet message headers of the email used for debugging and email threading purposes.

isClicked.description: Indicates whether the individual copy of the list email is clicked true or false. The default value is false.

IsLinkTracked.description: Indicates whether there are any URLs in the email that can be tracked (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

IsOpenTracked.description: Indicates whether the email is trackable (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

IsOpened.description: Indicates whether the email has been opened (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

LastClickedDate.description: The timestamp when the email was last clicked.

LastOpenedDate.description: The timestamp when the email was last opened.

ListEmailId.description: The ID of the list email that's associated with the email.

MessageIdentifier.description: The internet ID of an email.

Name.description: The name of the list email sent result.

Reason.description: Indicates the reason why a list email failed to send. Possible values are: Bounced DomainUnauthorized- Unauthorized Domain NoEmail - No Email Address OptedOut - Opted Out OutOfOffice - Out of Office Restricted - Restricted Address SoftBounced - Soft Bounced

RecipientId.description: The ID of the individual list email recipient. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

Result.description: Indicates the result of the sent list email. Possible values are: Failed NotSent Sent

ThreadIdentifier.description: The thread ID of the email.
